entries.description: Cinematic optimization for physical consistency, dynamic motion, shot continuity, anatomy, facial expression, lip sync, reference-image control, and fewer unwanted subtitles.
entries.promptExample: 0-2s: a detective enters a rain-soaked station, slow dolly in, blue neon reflections, distant traffic and footsteps. 2-5s: she turns toward camera as the light changes, close-up, natural expression, 无字幕.
dependencies: Use the workflow-required internal Licon, IC-LORA, and distilled LoRAs unchanged.
limitations: First/last-frame mode is recommended for stronger scene control.
Audio may become muffled in some multi-pass workflows; creator/community evidence is not a controlled benchmark.
Large 2.51 GB LoRA.
entries.license: Original Civitai commercial-use terms were not fully exposed in the saved source; verify before commercial use. A mirror labels the file Apache-2.0, which does not replace original terms.

entries.description: Reinforces a deliberate hard-cut transition between two clearly described shots in one generation.
entries.promptExample: A wide shot of a lone rider crossing a dusty plain at sunset. Cinematic hard cut to a tight close-up of the rider's eyes beneath a weathered hat, wind lifting dust past the lens.
dependencies: A prompt that clearly describes both the first and second shot.
limitations: LTX 2.3 can already create hard cuts, so this is intended only when stronger consistency is needed.
Weak or ambiguous two-shot prompts may not produce a deliberate edit.
entries.license: Original Civitai commercial-use terms were not fully exposed in the saved source; verify before commercial use. The saved mirror license is OpenRAIL++.

entries.description: Prompt-driven camera tilt, pan, and zoom controls for LTX 2.3.
triggerWords: the camera pans to the left
the camera pans to the right
entries.promptExample: A cyclist waits beside a mountain road; the camera pans to the right, revealing a deep valley filled with morning fog.
dependencies: Use one documented camera phrase exactly.
limitations: OTG TEST starting value; creator did not publish a strength. Physically validate before PROD.
Only the listed tilt, pan, and zoom phrases are documented.
entries.license: LTXV2 license label; the accessible creator disclosure limits use to experimental, educational, and non-commercial purposes.

entries.description: A broad 1990s 2D anime aesthetic and motion style trained from multiple show sources.
entries.promptExample: ANIMSTY, a lone pilot runs across a rain-lit launch deck, hand-drawn cel shading, dynamic cloth and hair, SHW_GITS.
dependencies: Use ANIMSTY; optionally add one documented SHW_* tag.
limitations: OTG TEST starting value; creator did not publish a strength. Physically validate before PROD.

entries.description: Removes foreground occlusions, haze, smoke, and clutter while reconstructing a scene from details visible across input frames.
entries.promptExample: Remove the road sign from the foreground and reconstruct the brick wall visible in adjacent frames.
dependencies: Creator companion configuration file installed beside the checkpoint
